title: The Fastest Way To Lose Stubborn Love Handles
hook: You can lose 20 pounds, see a thinner face in the mirror, and still have love handles. They're some of the last fat to go.
body:
But side bends and twists won't burn them. You can't spot reduce fat. Working the muscle under the fat doesn't burn the fat on top of it.

So lower your total body fat. Track your calories with AI and cut liquid calories. Soda, juice, sweet coffee, and alcohol. Lift to keep your muscle, and weigh yourself every morning so you can see the trend going down.

I was stuck at about 192 pounds. After getting on Zepbound, I got down to 175 in about three months. Talk to your doctor before making that decision.
close: Add lateral raises and vacuums to make your waist look smaller while the fat comes off. Pick one thing you're not doing yet and start this week.
pinned_comment: What's harder for you: losing weight, or losing the last fat around your waist?
